SELECT i.*, iu.message, iu.status, iu.created_at as update_at FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT iu1.* FROM incident_updates iu1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT status, MAX(created_at) as max_at FROM incident_updates GROUP BY status ) iu2 ON iu1.incident_id = iu2.incident_id AND iu1.created_at = iu2.max_at ) iu ON iu.incident_id = i.id;
SELECT visible.name as group_name, COUNT(c.id) as component_count FROM component_groups cg LEFT JOIN components c ON c.group_id = cg.id GROUP BY visible.id, cg.name;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actions WHERE created_at >= 'date';
SELECT class_name, COUNT(*) as count FROM actions GROUP BY class_name;

SELECT strftime('string', created_at) as period, COUNT(*) as count FROM actions WHERE created_at >= 'date' GROUP BY information ORDER BY created_at;

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY class_name ORDER BY id DESC) as rn FROM actions ) WHERE rn = 1;
